summaries.ai_product: Full-stack engineer building AI-powered products with React, TypeScript, Node.js and MongoDB. Leads engineering at Tututor.ai / EduNova across education software, shared backend services and mobile apps. Advanced spoken and written English. Available immediately.
summaries.full_stack: Full-stack engineer who ships fast with TypeScript, Node.js / Express, React and Next.js, on SQL / PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis. Leads engineering at Tututor.ai / EduNova across eight products used by 20,000+ students, teachers and families, running a shared Express backend of about 1,000 endpoints with Socket.io / Redis real-time messaging. Built a paid AI writing SaaS with multi-model LLM fallbacks. Comfortable in small teams with high ownership. Based in Pakistan. Available immediately.
summaries.frontend: Product-focused frontend engineer building React and TypeScript applications, reusable interfaces and data-rich workflows. Leads engineering at Tututor.ai / EduNova, with end-to-end experience across Node.js APIs, AI integrations and mobile apps. Earlier work includes analytics, file management and multilingual booking products. Available immediately.

bullets.text: Lead engineering across eight connected education products used by 20,000+ students, teachers and families.
Build and maintain a shared Express / MongoDB backend with approximately 1,000 API endpoints and 90 models, including school-scoped data access.
Ship teacher workflows for lesson-topic chatbots, AI quiz generation, automated grading and class insights; moved AI calls and API keys server-side.
Deliver Socket.io / Redis messaging, R2 file storage, Stripe and SEPA billing, and three React Native apps released on both app stores.
Led a small team across mobile and web delivery; now work directly with the founder on product and engineering.
Built a Plumier XXI data export with 1,833 of 1,833 golden-test cases passing.
Built reusable React components and hooks across client products, alongside Node.js / Express integrations, authentication and payment workflows.
Delivered Jurri file, inbox and password-vault interfaces; reduced initial load time by approximately 40% through code splitting, lazy loading and bundle optimization.
